purpose: Blind hypothetical commercial supplement for later production mapping. No repository, implementation, internal policy, existing evaluation cases or labels were read.
judgment_status: All judgments are provisional, not ground truth.

definitions.facts: All numerical premises, independent verification records and business constraints are fictional, not observed real-account facts.
definitions.conversions: Deduplicated paid orders unless explicitly marked as misleading Ads reporting.
definitions.conversion_value: Realized revenue after refunds, not contribution, unless explicitly marked as misleading Ads reporting.
definitions.contribution_before_ad_spend: Revenue less variable product, fulfillment and payment costs; excludes advertising and fixed overhead.
definitions.contribution_after_ad_spend: Contribution before advertising minus advertising spend; not full accounting profit.
definitions.target_CPA: Stated hypothetical advertiser goal, not an internal policy threshold.
definitions.high_risk: Author flags material commercial or measurement hazards; not an internal policy tier.
definitions.expected_action: Provisional commercial label only, not execution permission. Abstain means no budget/pause action on supplied facts.
definitions.sources: Official Google Ads documentation supplies reasoning concepts only, not evidence for fictional figures or prescribed labels.
definitions.null: Unknown or undefined; not zero and not estimated.

method: Authored independently from official public Google Ads Help. Varied marginal economics, value mix, account context, settlement, learning, conversion reliability, cash constraints and segment composition. No production decision mapping, internal thresholds or engine calls.

cases.title: Funded expansion backed by profitable marginal demand

facts.other_constraints: No learning, policy, billing, stock or service restriction; capacity for 10 extra orders daily. No recent targeting changes.

facts.method: Hypothetical independent paid-order ledger reconciliation to click cohort, deduplicated transaction records, refunds, payment receipts and variable costs; checked separately from Ads reporting.
facts.note: No discrepancy; purchase-only goals. All orders and refunds reconciled.

facts.independent_verification: Hypothetical separate order-ledger reconciliation; excludes focal campaign; identical settled click cohort and lag bounds.

marginal_evidence.design: Hypothetical randomized non-overlapping geo holdout in the settled window; no cross-geo delivery. Totals above include treated geos.
marginal_evidence.uncertainty: Small experiment; wider expansion may differ.

facts.misleading_fact: A budget badge alone might be treated as proof of profitability.

cases.rationale: Provisional commercial judgment, not ground truth: Funded expansion is commercially useful given verified contribution and direct marginal evidence. Lost impressions indicate potential reach, without guaranteeing incremental profit.

cases.title: Blended profitability hides an avoidable loss-making segment

facts.other_constraints: No learning, stock or billing restriction. Mutually exclusive product segments have separate ad groups and landing pages; neither requires the other. No demonstrated marginal demand for the profitable segment.

facts.method: Hypothetical independent paid-order ledger reconciliation to click cohort, deduplicated transaction records, refunds, payment receipts and variable costs; checked separately from Ads reporting.
facts.note: No discrepancy; purchase-only goals. All orders and refunds reconciled.

facts.independent_verification: Hypothetical separate order-ledger reconciliation; excludes focal campaign; identical settled click cohort and lag bounds.

facts.segment_verification: Both segment ledgers reconcile exactly to campaign totals; same settled click dates and lag bounds.
facts.misleading_claim: Blended CPA USD 40 beats target USD 50, so all traffic deserves more budget.
facts.implementation_dependency: Review removal of the independently loss-making segment while preserving profitable demand; reducing budget alone cannot guarantee traffic mix.

cases.rationale: Provisional commercial judgment, not ground truth: Reduce total allocation alongside segment review to avoid verified losses while protecting profitable orders. Positive blended results conceal avoidable waste; traffic-mix control must accompany any implementation.
